0.original: Hien is ready to undertake the challenge of Bardam's Mettle.

1.original: If you are to participate in the Naadam and fight alongside the Mol, you must first be recognized as a warrior of the Steppe. To earn this honor, you will be required to complete a rite of passage involving walking in the footsteps of the legendary Bardam and taming a yol. Steeling yourselves, you and your comrades set forth upon the peril-fraught path of the hero's namesake.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Challenge Bardam's Mettle with other players via the Duty Finder, or with a party of NPCs via Duty Support. Both systems are accessible from the main menu as well as the dungeon's entrance point.

2.original: At the end of a strange and bewildering journey through Bardam's Mettle, you manage to tame a wild yol in the traditional fashion. Trial complete, you leave with your comrades.

3.original: You emerge back at the entrance, breathing a sigh of relief. Wondering what happens next, you turn to speak with Lyse.

4.original: Suddenly recalling the whistles entrusted to her by Cirina, Lyse brings them forth, handing one to you. With a blow, you summon your respective yols, which circle in the skies above in acknowledgement of your new bond. There can be no doubt: you are now warriors of the Steppe.

48.original: <huff> <puff> This is it! The real trial!

49.original: Tread softly. We are for hallowed ground, and the kami are restless...

50.original: Nothing left but to begin, then.

51.original: To complete the trial, we must pass through Bardam's Mettle and each tame a yol. How precisely we are to do this, I am not sure, but since countless warriors before us have succeeded, I imagine we'll muddle through somehow...

52.original: But enough talk! We have a Naadam to win!

53.original: First the trial, then the Naadam, then Doma, then Ala Mhigo! We'll be back home before you know it!

54.original: Quite frankly, if I cannot convince a large bird to follow me, then what hope do I have with the Xaela? Or my own countrymen, for that matter.

55.original: I have stood upon more battlefields than I can count and lived to tell the tale. No bird will be my downfall!

59.original: Well fought back there, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Things got hairy at times, but I knew we'd manage!

60.original: Oh, right. I've still got those whistles Cirina gave me.

61.original: Here's yours. I suppose we ought to give them a try like she said.

63.original: I think that means we've won them over. That one there is yours, right? The other one is mine. Awww...

64.original: So that's that, then! We're officially warriors of the Steppe!
